reason: Batch 003 source audit corrected the wrong Group D storage premise. PD 1096 classifies Group D as Institutional and Group G as Storage and Hazardous; RA 9514 supplies protected-exit and special-hazard rules.

proposed.text: A four-storey building review shows: (1) a protected exit stair enclosure rated only 1.5 hours and (2) a Group G chemical storage room beside an office with only a 2-hour separation. How many of these two items are non-compliant under the checked source rules?

options.text: Cannot be evaluated from any source

proposed.rationale: A protected exit connecting four or more storeys needs at least two-hour fire resistance, and hazardous storage greater than normal occupancy needs at least four-hour fire resistance, automatic protection, or both.
proposed.explanation: The edit removes the old Group D storage item and keeps only source-backed RA 9514 conditions.
